**Restatement:** As an actuarial assistant, I will evaluate the frequency prediction model for insurance claims by reviewing its data preparation and modeling phases.

**Critical Evaluation Actions:**

* **DataPrepAgent (Cleaning/Preprocessing):**
  • Check for data quality, completeness, and consistency.
  • Verify data sources, formats, and scales.
  • Identify and handle missing values, outliers, and data normalization.
  • Assess variable selection and transformation (e.g., log transformation).
* **ModellingAgent (Model Training/Predictive Performance):**
  • Evaluate model selection (e.g., Poisson, Negative Binomial, Zero-Inflated) and hyperparameter tuning.
  • Assess model assumptions (e.g., independence, homoscedasticity).
  • Evaluate model performance metrics (e.g., Mean Absolute Error, Mean Squared Error).
  • Compare model performance across different scenarios (e.g., different policyholder segments).
